summary: This is a routine 6-K filing reporting the successful passage of all resolutions at GDS Holdings' 2026 Annual General Meeting, including re-election of directors, extension of an equity incentive plan, and auditor appointments. Two directors stepped down for personal reasons and were replaced. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is disclosed. The filing is a standard corporate governance update with no deal terms or event-driven catalyst. Therefore, it does not qualify as a special situation.
